senses.gloss:
गुत्स गुत्स, अस्, m. (said to be fr. गुध्), a
bunch, a bundle, a cluster of blossoms, a nosegay; a
clump of grass; a pearl necklace consisting of thirty-
two strings; a plant or perfume, commonly Gan-
thiāla, = ग्रन्थि-पर्ण; [cf. गुच्छ.]
—गुत्सार्-
ध (˚स-अर्˚), अस्, m. a necklace or garland of
twenty-four strings; [cf. गुच्छार्ध.]

गुत्सक, अस्, m. a bundle, a bunch, a nosegay, a
cluster of blossoms; a chowri, a cow-tail; a section
of a work; [cf. गुच्छ and गुच्छक.]
—गुत्सक-
पुष्प, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = गुच्छक-पुष्प
= सप्त-च्छद.
